routines.text: Buƙatun da ake aikawa da kansu bisa jadawali. Babu abin da ke gudana idan wannan shafi a rufe yake: abin da lokacinsa ya yi a lokacin ana yin sa idan ka dawo.
routines.none: Babu ayyukan lokaci-lokaci tukuna. Nemi a yi wani abu kowace awa, rana, mako ko wata, ko tunatarwa don safiyar Alhamis.
routines.starter.news.request: Muhimman labaran yau a cikin maki biyar gajeru, kowanne da tushensa.
routines.starter.week.request: Tambaye ni abin da nake da shi a wannan makon, sannan ka taimake ni in jera su: me zai fara da me zai iya jira.
routines.starter.review.request: Taimake ni in duba makona: abin da aka gama, abin da har yanzu a buɗe yake, da abin da zan kai mako mai zuwa.
routines.starter.learn.request: Koya mini abu ɗaya mai amfani cikin mintuna biyar, kowace rana a kan wani batu daban.
routines.when.file: Duk lokacin da aka raba fayil
routines.when.made: Duk lokacin da aka yi fayil
routines.if: Sai idan amsar e ce ga
routines.name: Suna
routines.late: A makare: wannan shafi yana rufe a {time}
routines.plan.month: Kowane wata, a rana ta {day}, da {time}
